Why does this repository qualify?: PetWaymark is a free, neutral open-source dog/cat travel research tool: deterministic offline engine, bilingual checklists, pinned read-only rule reuse, emergency preparation and correction privacy previews. Code is Apache-2.0; curated data is CC BY 4.0. All 15 rules remain drafts; verified routes and documented independent adoption are zero. Future reuse could reduce duplicated rule-checking work. No external integration or transport capacity is claimed.
How will you use API credits for your pr: Proposed use: draft official-source change summaries, suggest regression cases and assist issue triage and release notes. A maintainer would review every output; AI would never verify legal rules or confirm travel. No API runtime dependency exists today. Organization ID, usage estimates and budget caps remain to be filled before submission.
Anything else we should know?: v0.1.0 is a research preview; main adds maintenance evidence and offline reuse. There are 207 Python tests, 48 overlapping synthetic audit cases and 22 fixed bilingual demo examples. Public commits and CI are linked in docs/research/week12. Self-use and tests are excluded from adoption (0); voluntary human trials and qualified independent review are also 0. Planning weeks are task stages, not elapsed weeks. Human costs/downloads are unmeasured. No orders, booking or live capacity.
